description_en: Creates and starts an incremental backup set download task
description_zh: 该接口用于创建并启动增量备份集下载任务
kebab_example: aliyun dbs create-increment-backup-set-download --backup-set-id t4yh0g0g0000 --backup-set-name mysql-bin.000054 --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateIncrementBackupSetDownload

parameters.help_en: The ID of the incremental backup task. To obtain the task ID, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869833.html operation and view the value of the BackupSetJobId parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh: 增量备份集任务ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869833.html接口获取**BackupSetJobId**
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the incremental backup set. To obtain the backup set ID, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869833.html operation and view the value of the BackupSetId parameter in the response
parameters.name: backup_set_name

parameters.help_en:
The format in which the incremental backup set is downloaded. Valid values:

Native

SQL

CSV

JSON

Default value: Native
parameters.help_zh:
增量备份集下载格式。取值：
Native
SQL
CSV  
JSON

默认 Native
parameters.name: backup_set_data_format

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token

BackupSetDownloadTaskId.description_en: The ID of the backup set download task
